observations: Photo 0: Top view of a black Canon camera body with 'Canon' and 'EOS R10' visible on the front. The mode dial is set to 'M' (manual). The camera has a top LCD screen, a mode dial, and a shutter button. A hand is holding the camera.

Photo 1: Front view of the camera body with the lens mount open. The 'Canon' logo is visible above the lens mount, and 'EOS R10' is on the right side. The sensor is visible and appears to be clean. The camera is held in a hand.

Photo 2: Side view of the camera body, showing the grip, buttons, and the top LCD screen. The camera is held in a hand, and the lens mount is open. The camera appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show 'Canon' and 'EOS R10' clearly on the camera body.
All photos show only the camera body with the lens mount open, no lens attached. The seller's text confirms this.
No battery or charger is visible in any photo. The claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the camera powering on, displaying the menu, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Battery or charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the battery inserted and charging, or a photo of the charger and battery together.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery and charger

risks.risk: Sensor may have dust, scratches, or damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the sensor with the lens removed, or a video showing the sensor under bright light.

risks.risk: Camera may have internal damage or mechanical issues (e.g., shutter, lens, or mirror) not visible externally
risks.proof: Video showing the camera in operation, including shutter count, lens movement, and mirror lock-up.

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Photo or video showing the battery and charger included.
Close-up photo of the sensor with the lens removed.
Video showing the camera in operation, including shutter count and lens movement.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
